# Wellness Technical Solutions (WTS)

> Supplier of ultrasound machines, probes/transducers, parts and accessories for hospitals, clinics and diagnostic centres in Pakistan. Based in Rawalpindi, Punjab. Offers machine sourcing, probe matching by connector, part-number sourcing, room-ready setups and technical guidance.

Wellness Technical Solutions (WTS) is a Pakistani medical-imaging equipment supplier. Core offering: cart-based and portable ultrasound systems, convex/linear/phased-array and specialty probes, and OEM parts and consumables (cables, batteries, boards, gel, carts, covers). Customers send the machine brand/model and part number; WTS replies with compatible options, availability and pricing, typically within one business day.

- [Home](https://www.wellnesstechsolutions.pk/): Overview, services and quote request
- [Products](https://www.wellnesstechsolutions.pk/products): Ultrasound systems, probes and parts catalogue
- [About](https://www.wellnesstechsolutions.pk/about): Who we are, how we work
